shortcut: TLS certificate expiration causing production outage
detail: When TLS certificates are not rotated before expiration, nginx or other reverse proxies reject HTTPS connections with certificate validation errors. This causes a complete production outage for all HTTPS endpoints. The error is sudden and affects all users simultaneously. Manual certificate management is error-prone and often forgotten until the outage occurs. Prerequisite: understanding TLS certificate lifecycle and automated renewal. Requires automated certificate rotation with monitoring. To mitigate: use cert-manager in kubernetes for automatic renewal, set up expiration alerts at 30, 14, and 7 days. Fix: implement cert-manager with automatic renewal, add Prometheus alerts for certificate expiration, and test renewal in staging before production deployment.
